# Independent review: compiling standard proof cores at internal matrices

Verdict: CLEAN for final ModelCodedCoreCompiler source de85688c2c9a0fdefc5b05cdeac37f7515fae9b9b4bee3eebbf708e8fa9cc525 and audit c79c0c2b9bd559f813dc801e93f5450b43eab58ccae6d61bf538ab5e6d3b9eb4. The reviewer read the entire prototype and entire maintained-header final source, its complete4-probe/8-caller audit, both maintained project prerequisites, the heterogeneous hygiene module, and Foundation's actual standard Derivation/Theory.Proof and represented target interfaces. No Lean build or source edit was performed by the reviewer.

`compileCore` recurses on an actual standard finite Basic.Derivation. All8constructors are covered: atomic identity, cut, contraction, truth, disjunction, conjunction, universal and existential. The target sequent is the literal HFS-coded image of the source list, using an arbitrary typed internal arithmetic matrix S in an arbitrary IΣ1 model. S may have nonstandard code and arbitrary free-variable labels. Source arity, source formulas, source terms and the derivation tree remain standard Lean syntax.

At a universal node the source premise is p.free::Γ.shift. The recursive call uses S.shift; the two heterogeneous identities change this precisely into (translate(S,p)).free::mapSeq(S,Γ).shift, exactly the represented target universal rule's premise. The surrounding target theory T does not change. This avoids the previous fixed-S shift equation without asserting it: no FVFree or S.shift=S premise is introduced. Existential nodes use the already checked arbitrary-S substitution law; no matrix shift is appropriate there. All other constructors preserve the ordinary primitive target operations, including literal cut and weakening.

`mapSeq` handles collisions and duplicates through actual sequent membership, not an unjustified injective encoding assumption. `mapSeq_mono` recovers well-formedness of a raw member from the represented formula set before wrapping it as a typed formula. Append maps to actual represented union. Thus contraction/cut remain correct even when distinct source formulas translate to equal target codes.

Theory axioms are not silently assumed to be preserved. `compileTemplate` receives an explicit target proof for every member of the finite list d.axioms of its standard source proof. Source d.derivation is a logical core deriving the conclusion together with the negated embedded axiom list. `discharge` weakens each supplied proof to the residual context and eliminates that negative occurrence by actual represented cut. These witnesses are supplied at the root matrix S; they need not be invented or shifted at intermediate binders, because the recursion is on a purely logical core. No assumption that arbitrary source axioms map to target axioms is concealed in the definition.

The final theorem exposes Foundation's actual represented Proof predicate for the emitted carrier and translated conclusion. It is stronger than a semantic validity statement or an unrelated abstract calculus assumption. It is still external recursion on a standard finite proof template with explicit target witness data. No single represented compiler graph, arbitrary internally coded source-proof recursion, PA consistency comparison, or full machine/proof internalization is provided. The source Theory T1 and target internal theory T are arbitrary; the finite witness premise is material.

The8audit callers include generic core compilation, generic theory compilation and its represented-Proof conclusion, an already-shifted S, an actual no-axiom excluded-middle template for arbitrary S, an open fvar17=fvar18 matrix, the explicit universal constructor, and finite-list discharge. Four exact fully qualified endpoint axiom reports use only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound. The free-parameter examples supplement the universal result; they do not replace it with finite testing.

Final fresh evidence is /tmp/zfc-template-hygiene-core-final/verification.json. It checks all4local modules serially, then both audits: unchanged2prerequisites, Hygiene, CoreCompiler;6probes/14callers total. Core source3.062627s and audit2.071936s passed. Hygiene source2.086655s and audit1.854124s passed. New core retains1style warning, Hygiene0, old prerequisites9. Historical failed audit attempts and the earlier scratch header are not counted as successful final artifacts.

The reviewer independently rehashed all4emitted objects against this final record, all original/snapshot sources, both audit snapshots, every recorded before/after input, both recorded dependency provider source/object pairs, and the current pinned clean Foundation/Mathlib checkouts. Exact Foundation32e1a0956a8622fad067328ca1959729a7634428 and Mathlib81a5d257c8e410db227a6665ed08f64fea08e997 are reused built dependencies; their entire compiled closures are not freshly rebuilt or independently attested. The official absolute Lean4.32 compiler hash matches the independently verified169core compiler identity.

A narrow checker caveat was sent to the parent: the executed scratch runner's `assert __debug__` guard disappears under Python-O. The maintained check_model_coded_core_compiler.py now uses an explicit argparse error before any workspace/provider/compiler operation (reviewed hash 0b3eb99fa563b45385835fd22b7f61c5748973fd3f8861b1cba378cd57e901cf). This guard-only maintenance change does not alter proof sources and has not been described as the runner bytes of the earlier full Lean replay; that replay's original runner hash remains059fa909313d4854058492a8d4ebf76cbc832b128b4ce84248458cc6b298fb59. The parent separately tests optimized-Python preflight. Its before/after record covers inputs/providers/compiler; this review's explicit final rehash of all4fresh objects supplies the separate current object check. No source theorem defect was found.
